description: This file defines the UrlHelper class with static methods for URL manipulation, including query string building, compression, parsing, validation, and security filtering within the Drupal framework.

classes.name: UrlHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for URL processing, security, and validation in Drupal.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Builds a URL query string from an array, encoding parameters with rawurlencode().

methods.name: compressQueryParameter
methods.description: Compresses a string into a URL-safe, shorter format using gzcompress and base64 encoding.

methods.name: uncompressQueryParameter
methods.description: Reverses compression of a query parameter back to its original string.

methods.name: filterQueryParameters
methods.description: Filters out specified keys from a query parameter array, supporting nested structures.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL or path into its components: path, query parameters, and fragment.

methods.name: encodePath
methods.description: Encodes a Drupal path for URL use, avoiding escaping slashes.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Determines if a given path or URL is external to Drupal.

methods.name: externalIsLocal
methods.description: Checks if an external URL points to the same domain and base path as the site.

methods.name: filterBadProtocol
methods.description: Sanitizes a URL string by removing dangerous protocols like javascript:.

methods.name: getAllowedProtocols
methods.description: Returns the list of protocols allowed for URLs.

methods.name: setAllowedProtocols
methods.description: Sets the list of protocols considered safe for URLs.

methods.name: stripDangerousProtocols
methods.description: Removes disallowed protocols from a URL, ensuring safety.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a URL according to RFC 3986, for absolute or relative URLs.
